lookup_sources.scope:
Fresh injected/OS DNS IDs per exchange, with typed failure and abort cleanup.

Live random IDs may repeat. Checks assert request/reply matching and source
call counts, never sample uniqueness or cryptographic quality.

fixed_lookup_regression.scope:
Local recursive-server address lookups across deadline-bounded TCP exchanges.

Checks both query address families and both server socket families. No OS
resolver configuration, cache, retry or query-ID entropy claim.
